name: crv-web
description: Coleccionistas de Rock Venezolano — interfaz (buscador, fichas y CRUD sobre la API)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/copy-public-root.mjs dist
scripts.build:public: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --base=/crv/ --outDir dist-public && node scripts/copy-public-root.mjs dist-public
scripts.build:staging: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --base=/crv/ --outDir dist-staging && node scripts/copy-public-root.mjs dist-staging
